sourceFile: 024.MSU-20S15-07 Result check NTI test Frame improve R-PT_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid condition evidence but unsafe grouping and misparsed measurement outcomes require correction.
issues: Review title is taken from a FO data row, not the report purpose.
Normal condition appears in data but is not handled as baseline, reference, or separate comparison.
FO measurement subresults are misparsed from labels instead of numeric FO values.
SPL/THD measurement evidence cites mainly header rows, not metric rows.
IMP and NTI summary sheets are omitted from outcome grouping.
requiredUserQuestions: Should Normal be treated as reference baseline or excluded from the main comparison?
Is the primary change Test1 new yoke plus S/M jig versus Test2 normal yoke under the same R-PT frame?
Should SPL, THD, IMP, and FO all be retained as one validation case?
correctionPlan: Replace title and purpose with the report-level function/frame-improvement context.
Rebuild changed factor around Test1 new yoke plus S/M jig versus Test2 normal yoke, with Normal explicitly classified.
Reparse FO rows using numeric values and AVG row, removing label-derived stats.
Add actual SPL, THD, IMP, FO metric rows beyond headers for cited comparisons.
Group outcomes by Function, SPL, THD, IMP, and FO under the same changed-factor context.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Condition citations are adequate, but measurement citations are insufficient for final evidence.
